from collections import Counter, deque

def components(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    out = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx))
                        q.append((yy,xx))
            out.append((color, cells))
    return out

def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    comps = components(g)
    totals = Counter()
    for color, cells in comps:
        if color != bg:
            totals[color] += len(cells)
    target = max(totals, key=totals.get)
    refs = [(color, cells) for color, cells in comps if color not in (bg, target)]
    ref_color, ref_cells = max(refs, key=lambda item: len(item[1]))
    candidates = [(color, cells) for color, cells in comps if color == target]
    _, chosen = min(candidates, key=lambda item: abs(len(item[1]) - len(ref_cells)))
    for r, c in chosen:
        g[r][c] = ref_color
    return g
